languageOrder: Alternate zh/en and en/zh by task; one query per language and task. No repetition.
budgetRule: Preserve returned order and formatted text, count metadata and line numbers; truncate to a token prefix, then drop an incomplete trailing line. Never select by reference labels.
coverageRule: Any alternative may satisfy a unit; all source lines in that alternative are required. Validate returned line text against the fixed snapshot before credit.
aggregation: Equal weight evidence units within each task, then equal weight tasks within each repository; equal weight repositories in overall summary, separately for zh/en.
notes: No Agent or query rewriting outside each engine; frozen same source and bilingual queries for both systems.
Source-derived tasks authored by Codex before outputs; not independently annotated or a hidden public benchmark.
Engine configuration frozen before querying these repositories; no tuning during the comparison.
ACE and RepoNerve are called from the same Mac; provider hardware and indexing implementations differ.
Single run per task/language/system; no statistical significance or concurrency claim.
